issues.on_page: General administration 1,495,095 (p2 and p5 put all seven lines under the 'General government' heading)
issues.issue: The categories are inconsistent. General administration is 'general government' while the other lines under the same printed heading are 'natural resources/conservation'. The rules say NRD spending is natural resources/conservation. The split is defensible, but it puts 66% of spending in general government. detail[7] has the same issue.
The page does not say whether the grants are state or federal, so the category is a judgment call (already has a review note). detail[1] (detail_category 'other state aid') has the same issue.
